_comment: Where the slurm skill may read, write and delete on the cluster: the DESIGN.md 9.3 safety
boundary, read by slurm/scripts/slurm_ops.py. Hand-maintained cluster data, not version-pinned.
A missing or malformed file makes slurm_ops.py refuse to run; there is no built-in fallback.
user_dir_prefixes -> roots of each user's OWN directory. A remote path is allowed only as
<prefix>/<username>/<at least one more component>, and a download or a
cleanup there acts only on files that user owns.
project_roots     -> OPTIONAL shared project areas, empty by default. A remote path is allowed
as <root>/<project>/<at least one more component> only when the user is a
member of the group that owns <root>/<project> (checked on the cluster,
by numeric gid). Teammates' files there in the project group can be
downloaded; cleanup still removes only the user's own files.
Only list a project root whose project folders each belong to a DEDICATED project group with
the setgid bit set (chmod g+s). A root whose folders belong to a group everyone is in (e.g.
'users') opens them to everyone. Never list '/', a user_dir_prefixes entry or a folder above
one, or a software/reference tree such as /nfsdata/genome or /nfsdata/apptainer.
Entries are absolute, normalised, literal paths: no trailing slash, '..', '~', '$' or wildcards.
